Name: Seasonal Elliott Replacement
Author: luniia
Description:
The Seasonal Outfits mod is one of my favorites, but I personally prefer Elliott's look in the vanilla game. I originally just edited portraits for myself to use, but I thought that other people might want to use them! I changed his summer outfit to be more to my tastes as well. You'll need the [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450?tab=description]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] mod for this to work. To replace the files, you'll have to copy the "Elliott" folder and paste it into the Portraits folder, as well as the "Elliott_Beach", "Elliott_SpiritsEve", and "Elliott_FlowerDance" into their respective folders. You'll also have to paste the "Elliott_Summer" spritesheet into the Elliott folder in the "Characters" folder. This is my first ever time uploading to the site, and I'm not extremely computer literate, so please let me know if there's any problems or questions!


Designs for the Spring, Winter Indoor and Outdoor, Flower Dance, and Spirits Eve outfits were made by [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister [/url]in the Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod, which had ideas taken from the Seasonal Villager Outfits mod and [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/42368125]Tanpoponoko﻿[/url], although no assets were used. The summer outfit was created by me; however the spritesheet is an edited version of the one created by Poltergeister and contains some assets. The Beach portraits are edited versions of the vanilla game ones, and the Fall portraits are vanilla game. Elliott's sprite and portrait were created by ConcernedApe.

Downloads.Description: Contains the seasonal, beach, and festival outfits, as well as a spritesheet for summer.
